parameters.five_blocks: consecutive, disjoint 101/100/100/100/100 frames; no frame pair crossing needed
parameters.preprocessing: Subtract per-block temporal mean and each frame spatial mean; Hann time/space; remove temporal DC and neighbour bins
parameters.spectrum: sqrt-energy weighted mean of each spatial-frequency normalized power in a 3-bin tube at f_t=-v*f_x modulo 1
parameters.block_gates: dynamic std>=1; abs(v)>=1; not boundary; score>=0.10; score>=max(19 shuffles)+0.03; competitor margin>=0.03 outside max(3,15% speed); reversal<=0.25
parameters.run_gates: >=4/5 block transport support; >=4/5 agree within max(3,25% speed) for BOTH alternate frequency bands and BOTH spatial halves; >=4/5 same sign; saturation<=20%
parameters.aggregation: All five block speeds have equal weight, including failed candidates; accepted labels require explicit gates. Upper/lower wall speeds averaged without equality assumption; disagreement is reported.
parameters.selection: No tuning, band selection, run-specific method switch, class labels or inter-run prediction used

limitations: All acceptance criteria are empirical transport diagnostics, not calibrated error or formal significance.
The temporal blocks are not independent experimental repeats.
Frequency-band/axial sensitivity measures different optical scales/content.
A regional image wave is not an identified phase-material parcel.
Nonstationary optical wave speed is represented by five block maxima; sub-block variability and weaker coexisting waves remain unresolved.
19 temporal shuffles are negative controls, not a claimed inferential p-value.
Native profile archive is reused with hash; no new experimental data or spatial calibration.
final_joint_gate: At least4 simultaneous blocks satisfying transport, both alternative bands, both axial halves and saturation<=20% in ALL THREE regions. All-five-block mean supported only if all5 simultaneous blocks pass.
accepted_aggregation: Separate accepted coordinates use only simultaneously passing blocks; never present a failed block as accepted. Candidate means of all5 remain distinct. Initial marginal-gate fields preserved.
